brief:
A Palestinian sculptor and Lebanese painter, described as close as brothers, have devoted decades to transforming the violence of their respective conflicts into artistic work, Middle East Eye reported. Abdul Rahman Katanani and Ayman Baalbaki channel their experiences of war and displacement into their creative practice as a form of resistance against erasure.

The artists' collaboration reflects a broader commitment to documenting and memorializing experiences that risk being forgotten amid ongoing regional upheaval. Their work serves as testimony to lives shaped by conflict and displacement in the Middle East.

title: Palestinian sculptor, Lebanese painter create art amid war and exile
